options.title: Who is this for, and what problem does it solve?
options.body: Before building anything, get clear on two things: who's going to use this, and what problem or frustration does it fix for them? Write two or three sentences answering both — no technical words needed, just the plain idea.

options.title: Who's it for, and what problem does it fix?
options.body: Who is this for, and what problem does it solve? Write a couple of sentences — keep it simple, no tech talk needed.

options.title: Who's it for? What problem?
options.body: Who's it for? What problem does it fix? Write it in plain words.
